evidence_requirements.description: Exactly 500 registered elastic-structure model cells: 125 structures by four models, with immutable receipts, no retries, no imputation, and a0/C11/C12/C44 observables.
Exactly 42 fixed class-stratified held-out target structures reused across every grouping rule and excluded from every calibration hull.

Separate held-out hull width, direction, sharp-license, escape, and overshoot records for class, chemistry, structure prototype, composition-space neighbourhood, plus the non-confirmatory predecessor exact-tuple diagnostic.
At least 16 distinct non-tied applied held-out targets per scorable class-property under the v4 class grouping rule.

exclusions.rationale: Preregistered excluded_unavailable: no reproducible gated UMA checkpoint was available at lock time.
exclusions.subject: uma-family

exclusions.rationale: Round 5 measures elastic structures only; LiTraj/CI-NEB paths and barrier observables are a different campaign.
exclusions.subject: litraj-neb-paths

exclusions.rationale: Legacy Round-4 jobs use mutable or drifted execution identities; v4 requires dedicated digest-pinned jobs with maxRetries zero.
exclusions.subject: legacy-round4-cloud-run-jobs

exclusions.rationale: Leave-one-out escape is structurally determined by group size and cannot answer transfer to unseen structures; v4 uses one fixed calibration/test split.
exclusions.subject: leave-one-out-escape-estimator

exclusions.rationale: Operator-supplied grouping labels are forbidden; only the v4 hash-locked derivation is admissible.
exclusions.subject: unversioned-grouping-labels

frozen_hypotheses.statement: On fixed held-out targets, class-grouped optimal-bias correction under the unchanged direction and rounding-robust theorem gates wins on at least three of four powered confirmatory properties in each registered material class.

On the same fixed held-out targets, prospectively derived chemistry, structure-prototype, and composition-space-neighbourhood hulls are compared separately with class hulls for width, sharp-license admissibility, escape, and overshoot; only the 18 registered width contrasts are inferential secondary claims.
